frequency_question: How often do executive principals sign a renewal or replacement water treaty before the expiration of the preceding agreement?
membership_rule: Includes formal bilateral river or water allocation treaties nearing expiration where one state is a heavily dominant upper/mid-riparian and the other is lower-riparian; excludes unilateral declarations and non-binding memoranda of understanding.

cases.name: Indus Waters Treaty permanent implementation mechanisms / revisions
Lesotho Highlands Water Project Phase II Agreement
Columbia River Treaty regime reviews and operational renewals

coverage_note: 5 named major structured renewals; population is small because formal treaties of this scale are rare.
known_gaps: Excludes minor technical annex updates that did not require principal executive sign-off.
skeleton: Observed executive-level water resource treaty renewals and replacement agreements globally involving asymmetric riparian states.
multiplier: 5 hits out of 5 comparable major historical renewals where executive will was established
validity_reason: Matches the final resolution horizon of the target question.
